description: A package that reads navigator and document while it loads (dom-reader) makes the package that imports it (registering-plugin) one whose per-file evaluation by Jest shows: the plugin registers an entry id into a module-level registry (cyclic-registry) while it loads, and the registry throws on an id it already holds. The registry's two files import each other (index.js requires entries.js, which requires index.js back), as a package whose entry and internals share helpers does. Three files on one worker under jest-environment-jsdom, each importing the registry and the plugin: in each the entry is registered once and is an instance of the registry's Entry, and the registry's internals see the same module as its entry. The PASS lines are not kept: the order of three files of one size varies between runs.
